hero.title: Bicara tentang Makanan dan Memesan di Restoran
hero.text: Countable vs uncountable nouns, There is / There are, some / any, How much / How many, kosakata makanan, dan memesan makanan & minuman.

cheatsheet.heading: Kunci seluruh modul: bisa dihitung atau tidak?
cheatsheet.html: Countable (bisa dihitung, punya bentuk jamak): an egg → two eggs, a banana, biscuits. Uncountable (tidak dihitung, tanpa a/an, tanpa -s): milk, butter, water, cheese, bread, rice. Pilihan is/are, some/any, dan much/many semuanya bergantung pada ini.

cheatsheet.label: Interaktif 1 • Countable vs Uncountable
cheatsheet.title: Kosakata Makanan dari Modul
rows: eggs, oranges, an apple, a banana
rice, pasta, chocolate, grilled fish (sebagai makanan)

modes.label: Countable
modes.title: a/an + jamak -s
modes.text: There's an apple. There are eight eggs.

modes.label: Uncountable
modes.title: Tanpa a/an, tanpa -s
modes.text: ❌ a milk, breads, rices. ✅ some milk, some bread, a glass of milk, a loaf of bread ➕.

modes.label: Jebakan
modes.title: fruit, bread
modes.text: fruit dan bread umumnya uncountable: I eat a lot of fruit. Yang countable: an apple, a bread roll.

cheatsheet.label: Interaktif 2 • There is / There are
cheatsheet.title: Menyebut Apa yang Ada
rows: There isn't a banana. / There's no banana.
There aren't any strawberries. / There are no strawberries.
There isn't any apple juice. / There's no apple juice.

modes.label: Pakai no
modes.title: no = not any
modes.text: Modul: kita sering membuat negatif dengan no: There's no apple juice. There are no strawberries. Jangan dobel: ❌ There isn't no…

modes.label: Pertanyaan
modes.title: Is there / Are there
modes.text: Is there any milk? Are there any eggs? — Yes, there is/are. No, there isn't/aren't.

options.label: + some
options.title: Kalimat positif
options.code: Have some orange juice with your breakfast. If you want a snack, try some nuts.

options.label: − any
options.title: Kalimat negatif
options.code: Don't drink any juice between meals. Water hasn't got any calories.

options.label: ? any
options.title: Pertanyaan
options.code: Is there any milk? Have we got any eggs?

options.label: ➕ Menawarkan
options.title: Tawaran & permintaan → some
options.code: Would you like some coffee? Can I have some water, please?
options.text: Saat menawarkan atau meminta, pakai some walaupun kalimat tanya.

cheatsheet.label: Interaktif 4 • How much / How many
cheatsheet.title: Menanyakan Jumlah
rows: How many McDonald's restaurants are there in the world? How many cups of coffee do you drink every day?
How much blood is there in the human body? How much water do you drink every day?
How much is that altogether? How much is it?

flashcards.a: Bisa dihitung, punya a/an dan bentuk jamak: an egg, two eggs.
Tidak dihitung, tanpa a/an dan -s: milk, butter, water, rice, bread.
Tidak (dalam arti umum). Gunakan wadah: two glasses of milk, a cup of coffee.

flashcards.q: There's atau There are untuk butter?

flashcards.a: There's no apple juice. There are no strawberries. (no = not any)
some = positif; any = negatif & pertanyaan. (Menawarkan: Would you like some…?)
How many + countable jamak; How much + uncountable (dan harga).
Salah → How many cups of coffee (cups countable).
money, traffic, economics, tennis, music, transport, work, chewing gum.

ringkasan:
*RANGKUMAN P7 BAHASA INGGRIS: EATING AND DRINKING*
1️⃣ Countable (an egg, two eggs) vs uncountable (milk, butter, rice, bread, money).
2️⃣ There's + tunggal/uncountable • There are + jamak • There's no… / There are no…
3️⃣ some (+), any (− dan ?), Would you like some…? (tawaran)
4️⃣ How many + jamak (cups, students) • How much + uncountable (water, money) & harga.
5️⃣ Plural khusus: people, women, knives, wives, babies.
6️⃣ Restoran: Are you ready to order? Can I have…? Eat in or take away? How much is that altogether?

materi.label: Bagian 2
materi.title: There is / There are
materi.html:
Untuk menyebut apa yang ada di suatu tempat: There's a banana (tunggal), There are eight eggs (jamak), There's some butter (uncountable). Negatif sering dibuat dengan no: There's no apple juice. There are no strawberries.

Pelafalan: bunyi akhir kata menyambung ke kata berikutnya (linking): There's‿an apple. There‿are‿a lot of grapes.

materi.label: Bagian 3
materi.title: Breakfasts Around the World
materi.html: Listening: lima orang bercerita tentang sarapan mereka, yaitu Kemal (mahasiswa dari Ankara, Turki), Mi-Kyung (Seoul, Korea Selatan), Dimitry (Moscow, Rusia), Sonia (Recife, Brasil utara), serta José dan Anita (Valencia, Spanyol). Pertanyaan diskusi: What do you usually have for breakfast? Are the breakfasts in the recording the same or different from yours? Which ones would you like to try?

materi.heading: ➕ Ceritakan sarapan Indonesia
materi.html: In Indonesia, a lot of people have rice for breakfast. I usually have some fried rice and a cup of tea. I don't eat any bread in the morning. Perhatikan some/any/a di kalimat ini.

materi.label: Bagian 4
materi.title: Food: Facts and Myths (ringkasan)
materi.html:
Bacaan menguji enam anggapan tentang makan sehat:

  • Fruit juice is good for you — true and false: baik, tetapi bisa merusak gigi; jangan minum di antara jam makan, minum air saja (air tidak berkalori).
  • It's okay not to eat breakfast — false: tanpa sarapan kita lapar lalu makan camilan manis; camilan sehat: kacang atau melon.
  • Coffee and tea are bad for you — true and false: kopi jangan lebih dari dua cangkir sehari dan jangan sebelum tidur; teh umumnya baik, terutama teh hijau, tanpa susu dan gula.
  • Vegetarian food is always healthy — false: bisa banyak keju dan minyak; yang penting sayur dan buah setiap hari.
  • Carrots help you see in the dark — false: vitamin A baik untuk mata, tetapi tak ada yang bisa melihat dalam gelap.
  • There are ‘good’ foods and ‘bad’ foods — false: yang ada pola makan baik dan buruk; makanlah seimbang.

materi.label: Bagian 5
materi.title: some/any dan How much/How many
materi.html:
Grammar modul: Have some orange juice with your breakfast. Don't drink any juice between meals. Water hasn't got any calories. If you want a snack, try some nuts. Pertanyaan biasanya memakai any: Is there any milk? Have we got any eggs?

How many + countable (How many McDonald's restaurants are there in the world?); How much + uncountable (How much rain is there in the Sahara desert every year?).

cells: It isn't a good idea to drink ___ fruit juice between meals.
For a healthy snack, you can eat ___ nuts.
Don't drink ___ coffee before you go to bed.
Is there ___ sugar in your tea?
It's good to eat ___ pasta, rice or bread every day.

materi.label: Bagian 6
materi.title: Real Life: Ordering Food and Drink
materi.html:
Tiga percakapan di restoran burger, pizza, dan kafe. Kalimat penting (Exercise 3): Can I take your order, please? • Can I have two Super King-Size burgers, please? • Anything to drink with that? • Eat in or take away? • Would you like anything else? • Can we have the bill, please? • Keep the change. • I'd like to order a pizza. • What size would you like? • How much is that altogether?

Kata internasional yang mirip bahasa Indonesia tetapi tekanannya berbeda: restaurant, airport, hospital, café, hotel, university, snack bar, platform, terminal, college, information desk.
